title: Objective review
description: rb-triage-objective's output, ruled ahead of any per-slice disposition: a slice member needs to know which surfaces the run is chasing before it can decide whether a candidate serves them. triage-seal copies objective_review into the sealed record's own field of the same name verbatim -- it is not transformed downstream -- so this restates triage-0.1.json's inline objective_review shape (not a promoted $def; triage.py never grew one for it) rather than $ref-ing it.

predicted_surface_count.description: How many surfaces this pass expects the dispositions fan-out to observe, for the design's section 4.1 divergence check: a member reporting far fewer or more than this is a signal the slicing or the objective missed something, not proof of it on its own.

supported.description: Whether the catalogue's candidates can actually support the declared objective, independent of whether they should have been -- a breadth run over a corpus with one surface is unsupported even when breadth was the right call to make.
